Movies and filmed by John Warner, features Aishwarya Rai along with Rahman.  The song was originally composed for Bollywood film "Raavan" and its Tamil version "Raavanan". The film was remade in Hindi as "The Gentleman" in 1994 by Mahesh Bhatt starring Chiranjeevi.
